(born August 19, 1969) is an American country music artist.

He made his debut in 1993 with the single "What's It to You", which reached Number One on the Billboard Hot Country Singles & Tracks (now Hot Country Songs) chart, as did its follow-up, 1994's "Live Until I Die".
Both singles were included on his self-titled debut album, released in 1993 via Giant Records.
Clay Walker is an American country music artist.
His discography comprises 11 studio albums and a greatest hits album, as well as 36 singles.

Walker's first four studio albums—Clay Walker, If I Could Make a Living, Hypnotize the Moon and Rumor Has It—are all certified platinum by the RIAA, and his greatest hits album and Live, Laugh, Love are each certified gold by the RIAA.
